disposition_reason: Tables 1-2 print mean ± SD Pb and Cd for pasteurised, UHT whole, semi-skimmed, skim and flavored milk bought in Istanbul markets, with non-detect counts; Hg and As were not detected in any sample.

study.design: Market survey of heat-treated drinking milk
study.origin: not stated (milk sold in Istanbul, Turkey)
study.method: MARS 5 closed-vessel microwave HNO3 digestion of 0.3-1 g; ICP-OES (Varian 710-ES); Hg and As by hydride generation
study.qa: not reported (no CRM or recovery reported)
